title: Museum of Holocaust Art, Yad Vashem

groundCutout.basis: Locally expose the two occupied floors and their precisely bounded half of the photographed court. Adjacent pavement and raw terrain imagery remain host context.

buildingCutout.basis: Shared campus Q156591 with independent way74078306/native35184446167138. The named map POI lies beside the southwest long face; the museum's own labelled entry and Square of Hope photos identify that face and the deeply recessed portal. The ordinary campus aerial confirms the narrow gallery along the courtyard. Internal +X follows the mapped long axis south-southeast; +Z faces west-southwest into the courtyard. Heading0 bakes these signed axes into world east/south. Portal location at internalX -5.1m is an approximation guided by the named map point, not a surveyed entrance. No independent member Wikidata ID is asserted.

terrainReference.basis: Standard PMTiles and Terrarium supply the retained approach and the shared terrain datum. An open limestone court occupies the photographed inner square. Its two pavement sections meet on the same plane. The mapped road, upper plaza, stair approaches and the original heightfield are retained beyond the two cutout outlines.
